name: io.github.surendranb/music-mcp
description: Music MCP server for AI agents: searchable catalog of free, open-source, royalty-free music across Internet Archive, Wikimedia Commons, Jamendo, Freesound, and Incompetech — every result with license and attribution.

environmentVariables.name: MUSIC_MCP_JAMENDO_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Free Jamendo API client ID (developer.jamendo.com). Enables the Jamendo source (hundreds of thousands of CC tracks).

environmentVariables.name: MUSIC_MCP_FREESOUND_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Free Freesound API token (freesound.org/apiv2/apply). Enables the Freesound source (CC loops and sounds).
